page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7.32xlarge is a compute-optimized instance built on the KVM hypervisor and the x86_64 architecture. It features 128 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor operating at a base frequency of 2.7 GHz. The system is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU core.

This instance does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, requiring external block storage volumes for persistent data. Network performance is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 64 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput communication for distributed environments. The lack of local NVMe storage and dedicated graphics accelerators represents a key architectural tradeoff, focusing resources entirely on raw CPU execution and network capacity.

Given its 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the ecs.c7.32xlarge is designed for compute-heavy workloads that do not require massive memory footprints or local disk caching. It is qualitatively cost-efficient for high-density CPU tasks, such as batch processing, high-performance web serving, scientific modeling, and distributed compilation, where compute resources must be maximized relative to memory overhead.
